BiblicalUsage: A bottle is a skin for water, and it carries the story of Hagar and the warning of Habakkuk. Abraham gives Hagar a bottle of water and sends her away, God opens her eyes to a well and she fills the bottle again, and Habakkuk curses the man who puts his bottle to his neighbour to make him drunk.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bottle is small and the lesson is large: God fills the bottle Hagar thought was empty, and He judges the man who uses his bottle to shame his neighbour.
